issue.subject: Disambiguate gitea+smelt incidents in qem-bot+qem-dashboard
issue.description:
## Motivation
When introducing support for gitea PRs we introduced an "incident type" in qem-bot but in multiple places we still use a bare integer where it might be ambiguous. In particular in the qem-dashboard DB the type is not disambiguated so we might eventually run into an ID collission when the higher gitea PR ids match a lower SMELT incident ID.

## Acceptance criteria
* **AC1:** gitea PRs and SMELT incident IDs of the same numerical value can co-exist and correctly be processed in qem-bot+qem-dashboard

## Suggestions
* Look for qem-bot openqabot/loader/qem.py "IncReq" uses. This class defines "inc" as integer and a "type". Then lookup where this data class is used in conjunction with the qem-dashboard

journals.notes: Regarding naming I suggest the domain term: *submission* replacing the formerly mixed use of "incident" and "PR". In the specific cases of "SMELT incidents" and" "gitea PRs" the specific terms can still be used. I think "submission" is a good fit because everything that qem-bot processes shares the same lifecycle: they are submitted by a human/system and are waiting for qem-bot to accept/reject them based on openQA test results. So a PR/MR is a code submission. An SR is a package submission. An Incident is a maintenance update submission. In code proposed usage `process_submission(item)`, `SubmissionType.PULL_REQUEST`. I would avoid "request" as qem-bot uses the "requests" library and conducts multiple different kind of remote "requests".

Unless #190821 is also about qem-dashboard I don't think it is a blocker as the disambiguation is probably almost entirely to be done in qem-dashboard. (We might need to tweak a few API calls in qem-bot as well but this doesn't prevent one from starting with qem-dashboard.)
